## What this is

1.4.2 gives the sign-in page a cleaner look. The engine, the file format, the REST API, the MCP server and every other screen are what 1.4.1 has.

## The sign-in page

The page is now one card on a quiet background, with the HotLoop Cascade mark and name centered above it. Sign in is the one orange button. Signing in with a passkey and single sign-on are plain buttons under it, and the single sign-on button shows the Vord icon when Vord is the provider. It reads the same in light and dark and on a phone, and the language and theme buttons stay at the top right.

Nothing about how you sign in changed: the same fields, the same ways in, first-run setup, directory sign-in, the second factor, adding a passkey or an authenticator app. The page keeps its ids, so password managers and bookmarks behave as before.

## amd64 only, and why

This release builds amd64 only. Multi-arch ships in its own run, so the release after this one is a single small version bump that builds both. `stable`, `latest`, `1.4` and `1` list the new amd64 image beside the arm64 image they already pointed at.
